description: MANUAL audit (Claude, 2026-10-15): block-enforced auto rules on write tools that, read literally, fail on a policy-COMPLIANT call of that tool. Assumes a literal judge; actual behaviour depends on the Step 3 judge. Per-tool lists count only rules that fail on that tool (a rule inherited by several tools may be satisfiable on some of them).

post_state_consequent.why: consequent is the call's own effect (status changed to cancelled / return requested / exchange requested / pending (items modifed), refund scheduled, email sent); false before the call. Source: gold FACT sentences classified normative by S1.

dropped_trigger.why: 'after items were modified, no further modify/cancel' lost its trigger: NOT order_modifiable / NOT order_cancellable / NOT modification_freeze_active (predicate text says it is true).

contradicting_or_impossible_attachment.why: S3-C02-R2 requires 'pending' on return/exchange (which require 'delivered'); S3-C01-R3/S3-C06-R1 require 'only item options change' on cancel; S5-C08-R1 requires a payment_method_id argument on cancel_pending_order, which has none.

read_tool_circular.why: attached to find_user_id_* / get_order_details: the lookup requires its own result (read tools are not shielded in the Step 4 default).

cancel_reservation.why: 'at least one flight kept' is false for any cancellation (its own predicate text says so).

send_certificate.why: both fire on every send_certificate: amount = 100 x passengers AND amount = 50 x passengers. S5-C02-R1 (delayed complaint) and S5-C04-R2 (cancelled complaint) also both apply.

update_reservation_flights.why: 'must allow cabin changes' formalised as update_reservation_flights IMPLIES flights_unchanged: every real flight change fails.

cancel_reservation.why: permission became the only allowed case: non-business cancellations fail S4-C07-R4; business/insured cancellations outside 24 h fail S4-C02-R1/S4-C05-R3.

book_reservation+update_reservation_bagg.why: tier rules require free bags = allowance for a cabin without a cabin antecedent: for silver users and for gold business/basic-economy reservations two rules demand different free-bag counts.

book_reservation.why: 'no flight changes for basic economy' also attached to booking: any basic-economy booking fails.

airline_v1_addendum_note: Not audited rule by rule. Visible additions: S0-C02-R7 / S2-C01-R1 / S4-C08-R1 (retail authentication via email or name + zip, block on all airline writes: unsatisfiable, airline has no such lookup); S3-C13-R1 (reservation_id argument required on book_reservation); S3-C11-R2 (post-state on update_reservation_baggages); S4-C04-R1/R4 (cancel only business reservations).
